subject.title: fix(secrets): surface degradation in logs and doctor

question: Is it acceptable for existing operator log and doctor surfaces to expose the redacted SecretRef owner kind/id, normalized reason, cold-or-stale state, and reload retry hint as this PR defines?
rationale: The implementation intentionally expands operator-visible diagnostics on a secrets boundary; tests can verify redaction but cannot decide the repository’s acceptable diagnostic disclosure contract.

options.title: Accept the redacted diagnostic contract
options.body: Keep owner-scoped warning and doctor output after exact-head proof confirms no SecretRef identifiers or values reach those surfaces.

options.title: Narrow the diagnostic fields
options.body: Limit the published owner information or reason taxonomy if maintainers consider any current field too revealing for normal operator logs.

recommendation.title: Accept the redacted diagnostic contract
recommendation.body: Keep owner-scoped warning and doctor output after exact-head proof confirms no SecretRef identifiers or values reach those surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the merged owner-isolation and degraded-owner behavior that this follow-up extends.
